name: Nexus Surgical and Medicare Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Nexus Surgical and Medicare Ltd deals in medical disposable, surgical equipment, pharmaceutical products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NSML is in the business of importing and marketing quality surgical and pharma products at economical prices. It holds all the necessary licenses / permissions for Import of above surgical consumables. The company is a wholesale dealer dealing in various sizes of disposal syringe (with and without needle) and pouches of various size used for storage of sterilized equipment and material.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 57.5%
cons: Debtor days have increased from 57.9 to 85.5 days.
